verdict.rationale: Relay's own materials explicitly cover the full story: upload bills, automate approvals and pay vendors (relay-docs-4). It also offers multi-step approval rules (relay-docs-17), a support article on setting up payment approvals (relay-docs-28), and bill pay (relay-docs-27). Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how bill upload and approval routing actually work (approver chains, thresholds, the gate before payment), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the approval workflow.
